content.short: Clearpool is the first decentralized credit marketplace enabling efficient lending and borrowing.
content.description: Clearpool is a decentralized finance ecosystem that introduces the first permissionless marketplace for unsecured institutional liquidity. Through permissionless single-borrower pools, institutions can raise short-term capital while DeFi lenders pursue risk-adjusted returns, with interest rates set by market consensus. The system relies on supply and demand to connect borrowers with lenders, delivering open access to liquidity and competitively priced funding without the need for traditional intermediaries.
